gdp_level.label: GDP nominal, current prices, SCA (Eurostat namq_10_gdp, CP_MEUR)

gdp_real.label: Real GDP, chain-linked volume, SCA (Eurostat namq_10_gdp, CLV20_MEUR)

gdp_growth.label: Real GDP growth, QoQ, SA (derived from Eurostat namq_10_gdp, CLV20_MEUR, EA21)

cpi.label: HICP, all items, annual rate (Eurostat prc_hicp_minr, EA21)

cpi_mom.label: HICP, all items, monthly rate (Eurostat prc_hicp_minr, EA21)

exports.label: Exports of goods, extra-euro-area, seasonally adjusted (Eurostat ext_st_easitc)

imports.label: Imports of goods, extra-euro-area, seasonally adjusted (Eurostat ext_st_easitc)

debt_gdp.label: General government gross debt, % of GDP (Eurostat gov_10dd_edpt1)

deficit.label: General government net lending/borrowing, % of GDP (Eurostat gov_10dd_edpt1)

bond_yield_10y.label: 10-year government benchmark bond yield, euro area (ECB FM.M.U2.EUR.4F.BB.U2_10Y.YLD)

fdi.label: FDI net inflows, % of GDP (World Bank)

current_account.label: Current account balance, % of GDP, euro area (21 members, EA21) vs rest of world (Eurostat bop_gdp6_q)

business_confidence.label: Business confidence indicator, LT avg = 100 (OECD BCICP)

trade_balance.label: Trade balance, goods, extra-euro-area, seasonally adjusted (derived from Eurostat ext_st_easitc)

population.label: Population, total, mid-year estimate, annual (World Bank SP.POP.TOTL)

gdp_per_capita.label: GDP per person, current prices, calendar year (GDP divided by World Bank population)
